fusions.name: Decoy Throw
fusions.desc: A hurled point that deals 13 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and rushes you up to 5 tiles to the target.

fusions.name: Door Watch
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darts at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Longer Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Last Gap
fusions.desc: Against enemies at or below 30% health, you deal 14% more damage.
